name: cowork-mcp
description: Free Claude-Desktop-native agentic workspace: read, search, and edit files in directories you allow. Sandboxed, audited, undoable. Adapted in part from opencode (MIT).

workspace_1.title: Workspace directory
workspace_1.description: The directory Claude may read, search, and edit. Browsed with a native folder picker.

data_home.title: Data directory (optional)
data_home.description: Where the audit journal and undo snapshots are stored. Defaults to ~/.cowork-mcp.

rg_path.title: ripgrep path (optional)
rg_path.description: Path to an rg binary. Leave empty to use rg from your PATH; without it a slower built-in search is used.
